platform: Apple M1 Pro / macOS ARM64 Release; four workers
candidate: normal full Ninja build from the working tree on 12.6-jsonparse-async

implementation.platform: little-endian NEON; other platforms retain the original scalar call
implementation.fallback: After the first escape, another escape in a short prefix hands the remainder to the unchanged JsonParser::DecodeString scalar method.
implementation.allocation_and_gc: Same string allocation, rooting and DisallowGarbageCollection scope; no new heap object, threading or write-barrier policy.

protocol.order: AB BA BA AB for final pairs
protocol.adoption: Only adopt after a normal production rebuild, Release/DCHECK correctness and the final workload matrix. Preserve failed prototypes and all measurements.
protocol.interference: Before final timing: accept the first complete four-pair cell cohort with no observed active compiler at either process boundary. Preserve contaminated cohorts verbatim, wait for six quiet seconds and repeat the entire cell, at most four attempts. Never repeat or exclude based on timing results.
protocol.scope: Preserve the existing scalar decoding method. Long vector decoding may hand remaining input back to it. No allocation policy, threading, GC barrier or input ownership changes.

performance.scope: Six families at 10/20/50 MB for both APIs; 31 focused fixtures for both APIs; six real-input and five string four-job async controls.
performance.timing: API wall time includes natural GC, worker scheduling, materialization and Promise completion. Loading, explicit pre-round GC and full-result validation are outside the measured interval.
performance.resources: CPU and peak RSS are whole-process measurements including startup, validation and explicit GC, not per-phase CPU or allocations.
performance.compiler_exclusion: Only observed compiler activity at process boundaries triggers replacement of an entire paired cell cohort. All such cohorts are retained. Performance results never trigger resampling.

correctness.new_test_scope: Vector remainders and 128-character threshold; widening/narrowing; sparse/dense transitions; surrogates; long duplicate escaped keys; three-argument reviver source text.

pilot.disposition: All 48 focused pilot cells passed. Canada 20 MB sync failed the 3% guard at about 3.04%; retain this finding and use the complete normal-build qualification matrix for the adoption decision. Three pilot processes had observed compiler interference.

boundaries: Mac ARM64 performance only; Android ARM64/ARM32 changed translation unit compiles, but no device runtime or performance result.
No guarantee for tiny JSON latency, all input shapes or host UI frame timing.
Source and binary hashes bind the final qualification; isolated object-relink pilots are not final acceptance evidence.
